name: Navigation — navbar links scroll to the respective section anchors
description: Verifies that clicking navigation items (Overview, 3D Experience, Parts Archive, Collection, Contact) scrolls to and displays the target sections on the page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and scroll slightly down to make the fixed navigation bar visible
The fixed navigation bar appears with links for 'OVERVIEW', '3D EXPERIENCE', 'PARTS ARCHIVE', 'COLLECTION', and 'CONTACT'
The page smoothly scrolls down and the 3D motorcycle section '#bike-3d' is visible in the viewport
The page scrolls to the Parts Archive section '#parts-archive'
The page scrolls to the Collection section '#choose-your-ride' with heading 'CHOOSE YOUR RIDE'
The page scrolls to the Contact section '#contact' with authorized branches and direct inquiry form
